results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
results.summary: FOMC voted to hold benchmark funds rate at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026. Split 8-4 vote — last time 4 members dissented was October 1992. Third consecutive hold after three consecutive cuts last year.

results.title: US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
results.summary: May have been Powell's final meeting as chair. Inflation elevated in part from recent global energy price increases.

results.title: What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?
results.summary: Markets pricing in no changes the rest of 2026 and well into 2027.
